answer: A new agent identity must lock a refundable stake before it can earn, and that stake is slashed if its attestations prove false. Reputation then grows only from verified completed work, never from self-declared claims, so an attacker who spawns a thousand fake identities must fund a thousand stakes and do a thousand units of real work. Like an ocean that absorbs a single echo but not a coordinated fable, the economy makes each fake voice pay full price instead of letting one actor whisper through many mouths for free.
